contents.text:
I'm checking the docs for the full Program.cs, which the page has, so I can give the whole listing with its using lines. For settings, the page names .env, .env.secrets, and .env.{LLM_PROFILE}, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.secrets and LLM_PROFILE=ollama. I'll stick to those names and show the block as NAME=value lines.

I'm settling on the settings example now: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-key-here in .env.secrets, since the page doesn't name a default profile. I'll also point out that the listing loads CodingCatalog, so a custom agent would swap in its own catalogue.
